integrity: Exact integral cellular minors, rank over characteristic two, primitive degree-one cocycle lattice, product-spanning minor, and explicit torsion witnesses are reproducible from the accompanying standalone script; independent replication has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claimed integral cup-product theorem is restricted to the collision-free unordered two-point configuration space of the complete six-vertex graph. It does not give all relations, a general complete-graph family formula, or full automorphism modules. Potentially equivalent unindexed work is not excluded.
title: Integral degree-one generation and a torsion cup product for two unordered particles on \(K_6\)
